onset.Description: Recorded target marker onset in seconds from recording start; marker-to-display latency is unverified.

duration.Description: Zero denotes a point marker, not target display duration.

sample.Description: Zero-based EEG sample; native BrainVision samples are one-based.

block.Description: Execution-order block derived from the original main-task row, not renumbered after exclusions.

trial_index.Description: One-based main-task behavioural row within participant BEFORE any mapping omissions.

trial_in_block.Description: One-based order within the original main-task block BEFORE mapping omissions.

behavior_excel_row.Description: One-based worksheet row including header; traceable to the preserved workbook.

native_list.Description: Original Running value; randomized stimulus-list identity, not chronological block.

stimulus_key.Description: SHA256-derived key of experiment, native list, StimNo, StimType and both native strings.

native_stimulus1.Description: Literal Stimulus1 field preserved without alteration.

native_stimulus2.Description: Literal Stimulus2 field preserved without alteration.

prime_string.Description: Stimulus1 interpreted as prime from pseudoword placement in Stimulus2; program-level confirmation pending.

target_string.Description: Stimulus2 interpreted as target from pseudoword placement; program-level confirmation pending.

stimulus_role_status.Description: Explicit evidence status of the prime/target interpretation; raw fields are retained.

accuracy.Description: Original Judge1.ACC; 1 correct, 0 incorrect. Separate from timing and artifact flags.

response_valid.Description: Observed response code 1 or 2 and 0 < behavioural RT <= 2000 ms; correctness is separate.

response_time_ms.Description: Unmodified Judge1.RT. Zero or missing is not a valid response latency.

response_time.Description: Behavioural response latency in seconds; n/a if no valid response.

response_sample.Description: Zero-based recorded response-trigger sample, not calibrated behavioural response time.

complete_recorded_pair.Description: Target and exactly one response marker before the next target; does not establish a fully recorded display sequence.

prime_onset_reconstructed_s.Description: Target marker onset minus planned prime duration. No independent prime marker.

preprime_onset_reconstructed_s.Description: Target marker onset minus planned prime duration minus 500 ms. No independent mask/fixation marker.

target_offset_reconstructed_s.Description: Target marker onset plus valid behavioural RT, otherwise 2000 ms. Assumes documented response termination.

blink_onset_reconstructed_s.Description: Same reconstructed time as target offset; no independent blink-cue marker.

response_before_300ms.Description: Cumulative strict upper threshold on positive valid behavioural RT; includes correct and incorrect responses.

response_before_500ms.Description: Cumulative strict upper threshold on positive valid behavioural RT; includes correct and incorrect responses.

response_before_800ms.Description: Cumulative strict upper threshold on positive valid behavioural RT; includes correct and incorrect responses.

response_trigger_offset_ms.Description: Participant median(recorded_response_time_ms - response_time_ms), across all runs with valid responses.

response_time_residual_ms.Description: Recorded response latency minus participant offset minus behavioural RT.

timing_mismatch.Description: Absolute calibrated residual >25 ms; provisional audit flag, not a raw-data exclusion.

harmonized_posterior_avgmastoid_expbasel.Description: Posterior ROI channel mean then temporal mean; see processing_parameters.json for reference, baseline, filter and half-open window.
Posterior ROI channel mean then temporal mean; see processing_parameters.json for reference, baseline, filter and half-open window.
